result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your blood sugar test (HbA1c) was done on 29 September 2026. This test shows your average blood sugar over the last 2 to 3 months.

Your result is 52 mmol/mol.

A result of 48 mmol/mol or above is in the range for type 2 diabetes.

You do not have symptoms. So you need a second test to confirm whether you have diabetes. The result of that test is not known yet.

No diagnosis of diabetes has been made yet.

## What you need to do
1. Book a repeat blood test with the practice nurse. Do this within the next 2 weeks.
2. Book an appointment with Dr Thompson after the second test. You will talk about the result.
3. You do not need to fast for the repeat blood test.
4. Do not start any new medicine for diabetes before you have spoken to the doctor.

## Dates and medicines
- 29 September 2026: date of your HbA1c blood test result.
- Within the next 2 weeks: book your repeat blood test with the practice nurse.
- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What does my result of 52 mmol/mol mean for me?
- What will the second test show?
- When will I get the result of the second test?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
